title: What does a hiring manager WANT to see on a resume? 🔎
description:
If your resume is not getting traction, you want to make sure you're including the skills on your resume that the recruiter or hiring manager is looking for. Use ChatGPT to get the list of hard skills and work them into every section of your resume that you can. As a double checker to see which ones you already have on your resume, use Matching Mode in the Teal Resume Builder. #resumetips #resumetok #resumebuilder
